criteria.name: canonical planning
criteria.pass_when: Valid treatments preserve intent, duration floors, dependency order, state deltas, and canonical prompt sections without silent semantic changes.

criteria.name: fail-closed contracts
criteria.pass_when: Malformed, contradictory, unknown, stale, unsupported, or consent-incomplete inputs return actionable contract failures and never promote planned state to observed or accepted state.

criteria.name: capability negotiation
criteria.pass_when: Profile support is scoped per requested feature, expiry, mode, limits, controls, and evidence; candidates remain non-executable.

criteria.name: ComfyUI boundary
criteria.pass_when: API workflows, bindings, discovery, authorization, immutable pre-submit records, uncertainty, polling, collection, and provenance are enforced without blind retry.

criteria.name: observation and assembly
criteria.pass_when: Current content hashes, artifact/attempt links, required QA checks, media metadata, assembly order, and editorial limitations remain separate and explicit.

criteria.name: safety and provenance
criteria.pass_when: Sensitive references, credentials, paid/external calls, transfers, and disclosure/provenance boundaries fail closed and do not leak secrets into records or diagnostics.

criteria.name: package and CLI usability
criteria.pass_when: The package is independently discoverable, progressive-disclosure compliant, portable, JSON-valid, and exposes stable actionable CLI behavior.

criteria.name: documentation alignment
criteria.pass_when: Shipped behavior does not materially contradict the canonical docs; claims distinguish structural/software/media/provider evidence and limitations.
